escape.comment: `$(` opens it and the `)` that balances it closes it.

choice.comment: `?` and `:` between spaces in a value are a choice's — CSS has no `?` in a value and no `:` at its top level; a `:` in `url(http://…)` has no space around it.

comment: `$( … )` — the one way code goes into a block, wherever it stands in a value or a property name — and the two operators of a choice, `$(c) ? a : b`. `$` is this language's marker, as it is in `$color.line`; the parens are the region's own, so the TypeScript inside them is TypeScript. The TSX grammar pairs its own parens, so a `)` inside the expression does not end the escape.
